{{Quote|These Jedi relics are remarkably well preserved, Captain. Quite worth your ridiculous asking price.|Materrus|<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Materrus''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith pureblood]] who served the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Angral]] as a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Materrus was [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] with [[Color/Legends|orange]] skin and red [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and wore their red [[Hair/Legends|hair]] in a spiked style down the middle of their head with two strands of hair near their [[Ear/Legends|ears]]. While confident of their power, Materrus was weak-willed and [[Mind trick/Legends|easily influenced]] with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. Materrus carried a single red-bladed [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] and wore black [[Sith apparel|hooded robes]].<ref name="Opportunity" />

In [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Time">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> the [[Death's Claw]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] organization uncovered a shipment of artifacts belonging to the long-dead [[Jedi Covenant]] sect on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], and offered to sell them to Darth Angral. As he was [[Desolator crisis|otherwise occupied]], Angral sent Materrus as his agent to meet with the pirate [[Captain/Legends|captain]] [[Dugge]] and acquire the artifacts.<ref name="Opportunity" />

{{GameLS|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
Materrus and Dugge met in the [[Rasaaran storage facility]] on Taris and completed their deal without incident.<ref name="Opportunity" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|You can't win. Surrender is the only option.''"<br />"''I&hellip; I cannot defeat you. I must submit, or die.|The player Force-persuades Materrus|<ref name="TOR" />}}
Materrus first appeared in the [[BioWare]]-[[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', in which he is part of the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]]-class mission "An Opportunity Too Good To Pass Up."<ref name="Opportunity" /> At the end of the preceding mission, the player is offered a choice of missions depending on the player's alignment. [[Light side of the Force/Legends|Light-side]] players learn from the Imperial [[Spy/Legends|spymaster]] [[Watcher One]] of the [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[Rora Seake]] and her mission to eradicate a [[Lake Brell colony|Republic colony]], while [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark-side]] players are alerted to the sale of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] artifacts. The player can choose to accept the offered mission or ignore it, a choice that results in dark-side points.<ref name="Catching">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Catching Up With Watcher One|Taris}}</ref> During the mission itself, the player can Force-persuade Materrus to surrender and allow himself to be killed for dark-side alignment points, or the player can either talk to the Sith or attack for no alignment points.<ref name="Opportunity" />

However, this article assumes that the player chooses only the moral light-side options as a Republic character<ref name="Light Side">This article assumes that the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] classes in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' choose the options that provide the most [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light-side]] alignment points.</ref> and therefore assumes that the player was not told about the relics and that Materrus's deal was allowed to proceed without interruption.<ref name="Opportunity" />
